versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of Dataify YouTube Audio By URL skill.

- Submit YouTube audio file collection jobs via Dataify Builder by providing YouTube URLs and desired audio parameters.
- Guides users through parameter selection and displays a clear Markdown parameter checklist before task submission.
- Supports collection of multiple YouTube audio files in one task.
- Handles Dataify API TOKEN validation, including instructions for saving tokens for future use.
- Includes dropdown option presentation for fields like kilohertz, bitrate, audio format, subtitles language, and more.
- Returns task ID and status upon submission; users are directed to the Dataify dashboard for results.
